tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Get a real answer from one paid endpoint for free, exactly as a paid call returns it, so you can check the fields, dates and coverage before you pay. Pass the endpoint key from list_endpoints, such as snapshot, projects or series-permits-weekly.

tools.name: how_to_pay
tools.description: Get the exact URL to call for a paid answer, with its price, network and asset. Pass the endpoint key and the query parameters you plan to send; they go through the same free check the API runs before payment, so a query that would be refused or come back empty shows up here. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_endpoints, how_to_pay, get_free_series · Private data: list_endpoints, how_to_pay · Public sink: how_to_pay.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_endpoints, how_to_pay, get_free_series · Private data: list_endpoints, how_to_pay · Public sink: how_to_pay

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
